EmailTemplate.description: Notification email for opportunity owners about no activity for past 5 days.
EmailTemplate.name: PMC SS Opportunity Inactivity Notification Template
EmailTemplate.subject: Opportunity {!Opportunity.Name} has not had activities.
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Opportunity.OwnerFirstName},
Your Opportunity {!Opportunity.Name} has not seen any activity in the last 5 days. Please review the opportunity to ensure that it does not lose momentum.
Thank you, Salesforce
